scope: Restaurant and hotel Live spatial operating models
implementation: Demand-rendered Three.js scenes with locally loaded oak texture, soft shadows and studio environment lighting
Modeled restaurant tables, seating, place settings, counter, pendant lights, windows and planting
Hotel cutaway rooms with beds, linen, side tables, lighting, seating and floor selection
Orbit, shift-drag pan, wheel/pinch zoom, top view, reset and keyboard controls
Projected labels adapt to camera density; selected entities and allergy alerts get priority
Existing guest, order, booking, allergy and timeline records remain in the original table/room detail surfaces
Phone hotel floor selector moves below the model to preserve canvas width
Interactive isometric fallback preserves selection and camera controls without WebGL
Hotel money labels use canonical property currency formatting; no financial values were recalculated
Allergy, occasion and booking-remark badges coexist, with scoped current/next occasion notes in the context card

dataIntegrity.tablePositions: Existing service command table positions and IDs
dataIntegrity.hotelPositions: Existing hotel live floor geometry and room IDs
dataIntegrity.guestSignals: Existing guestSignals, tableExperiences and hotelGuestNeeds sources
dataIntegrity.layoutEditing: Remains in the dedicated floor plan editor; Live gestures move the camera

reviewFindingsFixed: Flat live geometry replaced with actual 3D meshes
Orbit event target now includes projected table and room markers
Arrival wave is placed after the enlarged hotel model in document flow
Label placement avoids overlap and reserves space for interface overlays
Current and upcoming allergy information uses separate lines
Rounded furniture radii are bounded by geometry dimensions

coverage: Orbit, wheel zoom, reset, top view and table/room selection
Two-finger zoom, keyboard pan and shift-drag pan in both demos
Guest allergies, next booking and restaurant timeline
Hotel arrival chart is below the model
No detected label collisions or document overflow
Existing layout editor furniture drag, persistence, palette drop, Undo and touch drag

limits: Architectural geometry is illustrative demo geometry, not a reconstruction or surveyed floor plan
Automated touch and WebGL checks run in Chromium with software GPU emulation; physical-device performance has not been measured
No external hospitality system, customer tenant or live guest feed was used
